name: Build Site
description: Build a Zola site from a sandbox folder with a zola.toml (/project/... or /shared/<this workspace>/...) into /public/<slug>, live at once, replacing what was there. Theme: the site's own themes/<name>, or theme = "<name>" with [extra.build] theme_from = "system" (the repo's, in /system/themes) or "<workspace>" (/shared/<workspace>/themes/<name>). No network; base_url is set for you; zola's errors come back if it fails.
author: anything

slug.description: The site's name in its URL; the folder's name if left out.
